concepts.name: 余烬·偏锋
concepts.design: An asymmetric broad offset-kite dagger, crimson and coral. The solid long blade has one huge angular convex shoulder bulging to the LEFT in its upper third, tapering into an extremely long centered oblique piercing tip. The RIGHT cutting edge is a nearly straight shallow concave sweep. The lower blade narrows diagonally into an eccentric thick root, giving the weapon a poised forward-heavy executioner's fang silhouette. Not a zigzag blade or serrated saw. One short red rectangular counterweight floats visually on the right silhouette but MUST be joined to the blade-root guard by a thick visible angular strut. Compact asymmetrical guard with one downward-angled wing above the hand, square-section comfortable straight grip, broad beveled hexagonal pommel. Minimal dark-red face, brilliant slim coral cutting bevel. A handful of tiny red rectangular ember chips escaping near the broad shoulder.

concepts.name: 流萤·缠枝
concepts.design: A double-braided jade and mint dagger. TWO thick flat sharpened energy ribbons twist around each other with TWO clearly visible over-under crossings in depth, forming three elongated open lozenge spaces and joining into ONE strong long piercing tip. The ribbons are wide enough to function as a solid blade, not wire or vines. The overall silhouette is a long slim swelling spearleaf, but the intertwined architecture is unmistakable. No organic wood or leaves on the surface. Distinct U-shaped geometric guard with two short stepped shoulders, both above the palm, elongated smooth octagonal grip and flat open-diamond pommel with thick walls. Dark emerald planes, jade ribbons, pale mint fluorescent edge strips. A few mint diamond motes weave near the crossing points. Make visible depth at the crossings essential to the illustration.

concepts.name: 寒汐·双鸣
concepts.design: An asymmetric tuning-fork long dagger, deep blue and turquoise. A single broad blade root divides into TWO long parallel substantial prongs separated by an OPEN narrow straight slot all the way to the top, like a dangerous tuning fork. The LEFT prong is about 15 percent taller and ends in a long acute slanted point; the RIGHT prong is shorter, ending in its own oblique point. ONLY TWO tips, no spear tip bridging the open slot, no trident. The two prongs are joined firmly by a deep U-shaped base well above the guard. One strong straight guard with two downward chamfered rectangular ends, a blue smooth straight grip with one inset thin cyan strip, short stepped cylindrical pommel. Broad opaque petrol-blue faces and turquoise outer bevels, icy cyan narrow edges along the slot. A few short blue horizontal dash particles suspended BETWEEN the prongs suggest resonance, no large sound rings.

concepts.name: 梦隙·回棱
concepts.design: A torsion-prism long dagger, violet and orchid. The blade is ONE solid continuous elongated prism that twists gradually through a HALF TURN from root to sharp tip; broad angular faces visibly rotate through depth, producing an architectural twisted obelisk silhouette. Three large rhomboid cross-sections merge into a continuous helicoidal cutting blade; NOT separate floating diamonds, not a row of sawteeth, not a crescent, not a flat zigzag. Slightly oblique camera angle clearly shows the twist and crossing ridgelines; preserve solid thickness and readable mass. The pointed top is long and elegant. A compact skewed hexagonal collar guard with an offset angular wing, comfortable straight slender substantial grip, angular flattened triangular pommel. Smooth dark-violet planes with orchid and lavender fluorescent ridges. Sparse tiny violet triangular particle flakes near the twisted ridges, local and subtle.
